name: Resend Inboxes
description: Hosts threaded email inboxes on your domains so agents can receive, search, label, and draft replies, with a built-in triage agent, via Resend's API, SDKs, CLI, and remote MCP.

skills.name: Threads
skills.description: Lists, searches, and reads inbox threads, marks them read, and moves them between inbox, archive, spam, and trash.

skills.name: Drafts
skills.description: Creates, updates, and sends draft emails from a dedicated inbox address that recipients can reply to.

skills.name: Labels
skills.description: Creates inbox labels and applies or removes them on threads to organize conversations.

skills.name: Reply and Forward
skills.description: Replies to received emails in the same thread or forwards them to another address.

skills.name: Inbox Agent
skills.description: Triages each new email using your instructions and saves replies and forwards as drafts for a teammate to review.
